applicationProcess.process_md:
> **Teacher applications:**

**Stage-1: Institutional Proposal Submission**

   1. **Proposal Initiative**: College/university takes the initiative to submit a proposal for hosting the STTP program.   1. **Proposal Content**: This proposal outlines the chosen topic, objectives, resource persons, budget, and participant details.   1. **Submission Platform**: The institution submits the proposal online through the AICTE portal.
<br>

**Stage 2: Individual Teacher Application**

   1. **Proposal Approval**: Once institution&#39;s proposal gets approved, it receives details and guidelines for participant applications.   1. **Application Procedure:** You, as a faculty member interested in participating, can then apply through the institute&#39;s internal mechanism or designated online portal.   1. **Application Requirements**:


    - Duly filled application form
    - Biodata and recent photograph
    - Curriculum vitae highlighting relevant teaching experience and qualifications
    - Statement of purpose explaining your interest in the chosen STTP topic
    - Recommendation letter from the Head of Department or Principal

basicDetails.schemeName: AICTE-SHORT TERM TRAINING PROGRAMME (STTP) (UT-J&K,LADAKH AND NER)

children.text: All teachers, supporting technical and administrative staff in areas of technical education.
Maximum 5 proposals per institute per year including sanctioned, earlier but not completed, would be considered. However, maximum 3 proposals per institute shall be approved.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
- **For Institution:** AICTE approved institutions.- **For Faculty:** All teachers, supporting technical and administrative staff in areas of technical education.
**Note:** Maximum 5 proposals per institute per year including sanctioned, earlier but not completed, would be considered. However, maximum 3 proposals per institute shall be approved.

children.text: ₹5,00,000/- to the host University/Institution for conducting the training for the academic year.
The full amount of the grant sanctioned shall be released as advance to the University/Institution.

The amount spent by the institute on the conduct of STTP shall be adjusted on the basis of utilization certificate and detailed expenditure statement submitted by the University/Institution on the prescribed format along with other mandatory documents viz feedback form, copy of proceedings and completion report etc.
The above said amount of grant shall be released on the basis of the Extension of Approval (EOA) issued by AICTE to the institute for the academic year.
Faculty training in the field of technical education with following type:
Subject related Training to teachers employed in disciplines: Engineering & Technology, Management, Pharmacy, Architecture etc.
Training related to Moral Values, Ethics, Behavioural Sciences & Attitude etc.
Training for teachers regarding orientation of newly admitted students.
Training for supporting technical and administrative staff including Librarian.

schemeContent.briefDescription: AICTE-Short Term Training Program (STTP) intends to conduct faculty training through financial assistance from AICTE to enable faculty members in the field of technical education.

children.text: Short Term Training Program (STTP) in North-Eastern Region (NER) and UTs of J&K and Ladakh intends to conduct faculty trainings through financial assistance from AICTE to enable faculty members in the field of technical education introspect learn techniques that can help prepare students for active and successful participants in a knowledge society.
It is a residential programme of six days. The approved STTP shall be conducted within six months from the date of release of funds.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md:
Short Term Training Program (STTP) in North-Eastern Region (NER) and UTs of J&amp;K and Ladakh intends to conduct faculty trainings through financial assistance from AICTE to enable faculty members in the field of technical education introspect learn techniques that can help prepare students for active and successful participants in a knowledge society.
<br>

**Duration of Programme:**
It is a residential programme of six days. The approved STTP shall be conducted within six months from the date of release of funds.
